title: Young swimmer to carry PH flag in Youth Olympic Games opening ceremony
summary: Young swimmer Jamesray Mishael Ajido will carry the flag for Team Philippines in the parade of athletes during the opening ceremony of the 4th Youth Olympic Games in Dakar on October 31.
